headings.text: Opens in 0.08 s. Written in Rust.
Skip spans come from the addon, chapter names or TheIntroDB, which you can switch off.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Stremflix-rs" (screen 2, 100% over a picture); "Stremio addons" (screen 2, 100% over a picture); "natively" (screen 2, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 4 screens in a row: "Search every catalog"; "Series that keep going"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Little motion: 14 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.
